parts:
Describe three people in your family that don’t live with you. Use some of these adjectives:

clever

shy

chatty

sporty

tall

short

 

Answer these questions in your description:

Who is the person?

How old is he/she?

Where does he/she live?

What does he/she do?

What does he/she like?

Do you see the person often?

 

You can start your sentences with: 

My ... is ... years old.

He/She ... lives in ...

He/She (works/plays) ...

He/She likes/doesn’t like ...

I see my ... (on Saturday/very often).

I don’t see my ... very often.
